Facets combine with AND: remove only rows where customer_id, email AND postal_code were all blanked down, i.e. rows that are a true full duplicate of the row above, not just a shared customer_id
first_name: trim + collapse internal spaces + titlecase
last_name: trim + collapse internal spaces + titlecase
email: trim + lowercase
country: cluster the ~18 spellings into FR / DE / ES / BE (from Cluster and Edit, key collision)
signup_date -> ISO YYYY-MM-DD (DD/MM/YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY/MM/DD forms seen in the data)
expression: if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/)), with(value.split('/'), p, p[2]+'-'+p[1]+'-'+p[0]), if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}/)), with(value.split('-'), p, p[2]+'-'+p[0]+'-'+p[1]), if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/)), value.replace('/', '-'), value)))

description: birth_date -> ISO YYYY-MM-DD (same GREL as signup_date)
expression: if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/)), with(value.split('/'), p, p[2]+'-'+p[1]+'-'+p[0]), if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}/)), with(value.split('-'), p, p[2]+'-'+p[0]+'-'+p[1]), if(isNotNull(value.match(/\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}/)), value.replace('/', '-'), value)))

description: loyalty_tier: lower case
loyalty_tier: fix the 'platinium' misspelling
French postal codes that lost their leading zero (4 digits, country FR)
phones -> +33612345678 format
expression: with(value.replace(/[^0-9+]/, ''), v, if(v.startsWith('0033'), '+33' + v.substring(4), if(and(v.startsWith('0'), v.length() == 10), '+33' + v.substring(1), v)))
